dedupe_resolutions.notes: Chevron's separately confirmed acreage agreement advances the broader Venezuela oil-development framework already tracked in this entry. It is incorporated as a distinct implementation track rather than published as a parallel event, while preserving its separation from the NABEP and Pentagon-linked arrangement.

The new section 202(c) order is a temporary operational PJM dispatch authorization during a heat emergency. NAT-2026-08-26-004 concerns a separate national emergency over foreign grid equipment and supply-chain security; neither duplicates the other.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement. Neither duplicates the other's event or unit.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

Both records arise from the U.S.-hosted G20 meetings on September 1, but they document distinct proposals in separate tracks: light-touch AI governance at the technology meeting and trade barriers responding to Chinese export imbalances at the finance ministerial.
